trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy and it unlocks automatically once you have earned every other trophy on this list. There is nothing extra to do beyond finishing the story, side strands, activities, collectibles, and the 100% completion run. Work through the roadmap in order and this will be the last one to pop.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission named Gone Fishing and the trophy unlocks at the end of it. The official description names the mission but gives no location or step-by-step route, so follow the in-game mission marker and objectives as presented. This is part of the main story path and is not missable.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through the main story until Chapter 1 is fully finished and this trophy will unlock on completion. The official description does not list individual missions or places, so simply follow the story objectives in order. Keep spoiler shield on if you want to avoid seeing later story names early.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Continue the main story through to the end of Chapter 2 to earn this trophy. The official text only confirms the chapter milestone and does not describe locations or choices inside it. No extra farming is needed beyond completing the chapter missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish all main story missions in Chapter 3 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. The official description gives no mission list or locations, so follow the story markers as the game presents them. This sits on the critical path toward the finale.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the main story to unlock this trophy. As with the earlier chapter trophies, the official wording only marks the milestone and does not name places or steps. Finishing this chapter puts you on the run-in to the final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission and this gold trophy unlocks at the end. The official description does not name the mission or its location, so follow the story to its conclusion without skipping objectives. After this, free-roam cleanup for strands, activities, and collectibles begins.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission called Breakfast Run to earn this trophy. The official description names the mission only and does not give a start location or walkthrough steps. Follow the in-game objective markers until the mission-complete screen appears.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist mission and the trophy unlocks on completion. The official text provides no heist location, crew details, or approach steps, so complete the objectives exactly as the game lays them out. This is a story-path mission and cannot be missed if you keep playing.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission to unlock this trophy. The official description only names the mission and offers no place or step details. Follow the mission prompts through to the completion screen.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission and this trophy will pop. The official wording names the mission but does not describe where it starts or what to do inside it. Stay on the story path and complete each objective in order.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission to earn this trophy. The official description gives the mission name only, with no location or tactics. Follow the in-game markers until the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Beat Operation Savage Glory and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. The official text does not include a start point or step list, so rely on the objectives the game shows you. This is another main-path milestone.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on your save file to unlock this gold trophy. That means finishing the story plus every required side strand, activity, collectible set, and exploration item the game counts toward completion. Use the in-game completion tracker alongside this checklist and tick off each category until the counter reads 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps or stunt events across Leonida and keep a running tally with the counter in this guide. The official description confirms the total but does not list stunt locations, so work area by area and revisit any stunt that did not register. This is a long grind, so chip away at it between other activities rather than leaving all 250 for the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Start every distinct activity type at least once and this trophy unlocks once the full set has been sampled. The official description does not enumerate which activity types count, so try each new activity icon you discover on the map. You only need one attempt per type, not a win or a gold medal.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge and track each gold with the counter here. The official description confirms all challenges must be gold but does not give target scores or range locations, so check the in-game challenge list for requirements. Replay any challenge below gold until the full set is complete.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each location where the event is offered. The official description does not name the locations or the number of tracks, so visit every Top Fun marker and win once at each. A loss does not count, so retry a location until you finish first.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races and log each distinct win with the counter in this guide. Repeating the same race does not advance the total, so spread your wins across different events. The official description confirms the count but does not list race names or start points.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge to unlock this trophy, and do it while Cal's strand is still available. The official description names the opponent and activity but gives no fishing spot or scoring details, so accept the challenge when offered and follow its rules. Treat this as missable and do not leave Cal's content until after the story ends.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game through to its completion screen. The official description does not name a specific cabinet or location, so use the first arcade machine you find and play it to the end. This is one of the quickest activity trophies on the list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission to earn this trophy, which means finishing every earlier job in Andy's strand first. The official description confirms the finale requirement but does not list mission names or locations. Treat strand finales as missable and finish Andy's chain before the story window closes.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand and complete his final mission to unlock this trophy. The official text does not enumerate Kenton's missions or where they start, so follow his markers in order. Finish the whole strand promptly because finales are treated as missable in this guide.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission after finishing the earlier missions in his strand. The official description gives no mission list or locations, so track Billy's objectives in-game and clear them in sequence. Do not postpone Billy's finale, as strand endings are flagged missable here.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida and count each finished strand with the tracker here. The official description confirms the total but does not name the eight strangers or their locations, so accept every stranger marker you find and finish each chain. Because individual strands can close, treat this as missable and clear strands as they appear.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand and complete his final mission to unlock this trophy. The official description does not list Randy's missions or start points, so follow his in-game markers from first job to finale. Complete the strand while it is available rather than saving it for post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission after clearing the earlier jobs in his strand. The official text confirms only the finale requirement and gives no locations or steps. Treat Tyrone's chain as missable and finish it in the strand window.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate once at every meditation spot across Leonida to unlock this trophy. The official description does not list spot locations or a total count, so check each spot off as you find it and use the in-game map to spot any you have missed. Work region by region to avoid backtracking at the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for and complete his request to earn this trophy. The official description does not name the animal, its location, or the hunting steps, so follow Bret's objectives exactly as given. Treat Bret's hunt as missable and finish it while his content is available.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets and track each finished set with the counter here. The official description confirms the set total but does not list card locations or set names, so collect cards steadily and check set progress in-game. Finish all three sets before focusing on the final 100% push.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK action at 100 different locations and log your total with the counter in this guide. The official description confirms the count but does not list valid locations, so try the action at distinct spots as you explore and confirm each one registers. Spread this across exploration rather than grinding it in one place.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges and track your progress with the counter here. The official description confirms the total but does not enumerate the challenges, so work through the in-game challenge list category by category. Many challenges complete naturally during story and activity play, so check the list before grinding the remainder.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, build up to a 4 star Wanted Level and then lose it completely and escape the heat. The official description states the star level and partner condition but gives no location or escape route, so plan a getaway before starting. This needs your partner available, so treat it as missable and do it during the partner window.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your Wanted Level active the whole time. The official description confirms the count and condition but does not name shops or routes, so pick three nearby shops and move directly between them. Because it requires your partner, treat this as missable and complete it while partner play is available.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles and track the total with the counter here. The official description confirms the count but does not list vehicle names or spawn points, so enter or register every new vehicle type you encounter. Most of this fills in naturally while exploring and completing other activities.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus to unlock this trophy. The official description confirms the takedown count and ability but gives no encounter location, so save Combat Focus for a fight with at least five enemies grouped together. If you fall short, let the ability recharge and try again in the next large fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA to earn this trophy. The official description names the place only and does not explain the exact action or route required, so explore VCIA and look for the departure interaction the game offers there. Try this during free roam when you can experiment without mission pressure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The official description for this trophy is deliberately vague and does not state a place, vehicle step, or count, so no specific location can be confirmed from the official text alone. The wording references Rhinos, which suggests a tank-related action, but this guide does not invent a spot or method beyond that. Check the in-game trophy or challenge hints and try Rhino-related interactions when you encounter them.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store from start to finish without being detected. The official description confirms the stealth condition but does not name a store or entry route, so scout the store first and avoid cameras and witnesses. If you are spotted, leave and retry the robbery cleanly.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one, tracking successful escapes with the counter here. The official description confirms the total but does not list bank locations or vault steps, so prepare a getaway vehicle before each robbery. A robbery only counts once you have escaped, so prioritise getting clear over grabbing extra loot.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape to unlock this trophy. The official description does not give a truck route or ambush location, so watch for Armored Trucks while driving and strike when you have a clear escape path. The trophy requires both the robbery and a successful escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the full map is revealed and this trophy unlocks. The official description confirms full exploration but does not list regions or a percentage breakdown, so drive, sail, and fly through every area and check the map for fogged sections. Combine this with collectible sweeps to cover the state efficiently.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang, one per gang, to earn this trophy. The official description does not name the gangs, operation locations, or a total count, so track which gangs you have hit using the in-game map markers. Repeating the same gang does not help, so move on once each gang is covered.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach to unlock this trophy. The official description names Ocean Beach but does not give an exact bar, time, or interaction step, so visit Ocean Beach venues and look for the cocktail interaction with a view. Treat this as missable and do it early while Ocean Beach content is open.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style to earn this trophy. The official description describes the action in general terms but does not name a showroom location or vehicle, so enter a showroom, take a display vehicle, and drive out through the showroom exit. Expect a Wanted Level, so have an escape route ready.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley to unlock this trophy. The official description names the alley but does not specify a score, game mode, or exact action beyond following through, so play a bowling game there and complete it. If a single game does not trigger it, check the alley's activity prompts for the required follow-through action.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The official description for this trophy is vague and does not state a specific action, place, or count beyond referencing a partnership. No exact steps can be confirmed from the official text alone, so this guide does not invent a location or method. Because it involves your partner, treat it as missable and pursue partner activities and interactions while your partner is available.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: This trophy is tied to story choices, and the official description confirms choices matter but does not say which choices or outcomes are required. No specific decision can be confirmed from the official text alone, so make story choices deliberately and keep a backup save before major decisions. Treat this as missable because a different choice path may be needed if it does not unlock.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The official description for this trophy is intentionally cryptic and does not name an action, place, or count. No specific method can be confirmed from the official text alone, so this guide does not invent steps for it. Keep playing through story and side content and check the in-game hints, as trophies worded this way usually trigger from a specific repeatable situation.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The official description for this trophy gives no action, location, or count to work from. No concrete steps can be confirmed from the official text alone, so this guide does not invent a trigger. Explore unusual locations and side encounters as you play, and check in-game hints if this remains locked after story completion.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by to unlock this trophy. The official description confirms the melee drive-by action but does not give a required count or location, so perform melee attacks from a moving vehicle against grouped enemies. If it does not unlock after one hit, repeat the drive-by on additional targets.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts and track the laundered total with the counter here. The official description confirms the money target and method but does not list contact locations or exchange rates, so launder bills whenever you hold them rather than stockpiling. This pairs naturally with robbery income in the late game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops and log your running spend with the counter here. The official description confirms the combined total but does not require any single shop, so normal purchases of vehicles, clothes, and upgrades all contribute. Save large purchases for the cleanup phase if you are short on cash early.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property available for sale to unlock this trophy. The official description confirms all garages must be owned but does not list their locations or prices, so check property markers on the map and buy each garage as funds allow. This is a money sink, so tackle it alongside the spending and laundering trophies.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and count each registration with the tracker here. The official description confirms the total and app but does not list eligible vehicles or registration steps, so follow the app prompts for each vehicle you add. Register vehicles steadily as you discover them for the vehicle discovery trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
